declared: 2026-09-28, in docs/CONSUMER-CHECK-PROTOCOL.md section 6, before the consumer was written
derivation: read off the contract's rules and the readings in section 5, not off either implementation
vocabulary: the snake_case spelling of the variant name in docs/TRANSFER-CONTRACT.md

cases.why: three facts and one capability resolve to a match, the coverage is closed, and nothing else is found
the differing key is one the author declared adaptable, so the difference is bridgeable and is not a violation
a required fact differs and neither the author nor the target domain declares a way to bridge it
the target never declares the key a condition needs, which is an obligation to observe and not a violation
the target declares the key unknown, which is a second finding from an undeclared key and reaches the same status
the target established that the key is not there, and a required value is not satisfied by an established absence
nobody checked the capability in the target, and not observed is not unavailable
the capability is known not to exist in the target, which is a known violation and not a request for evidence
the capsule declines to say how complete its own conditions are, so it cannot license a direct reuse
the capsule declares no applicability condition, which is a statement about the source and not about the target
every condition holds and a recorded failure was observed under exactly this condition again, so work is owed before proposing the intervention
a bridgeable difference and an undeclared key are both present, and a known difference outranks an unobserved condition
one condition holds, the other is undeclared in the target, and no difference and no violation exist
an absent condition is satisfied by an established absence, and the other condition matches
a predicate reference names a predicate no published consumer holds, so the condition cannot be established in the target and is owed as an observation
cases.contested_reason: docs/TRANSFER-CONTRACT.md does not mention predicate_ref. InsufficientInformation is also defensible, on the reading that a capsule naming something unevaluable has not declared enough to decide.

cases.why: a required fact differs and the target domain declares an adaptation covering that key, which makes the difference bridgeable
cases.contested_reason: the capsule has no field for a target-domain adaptation and the type that carries one lives in the moved planner, so this case is only reachable through the out-of-band declaration the case file provides.
